title: The #486 contrast clean expectations conflict with the body-independence contract
body:
*This was generated by AI while building #486.*

## What to build

Diagnose the mismatch between #486's contrast articles' frozen clean expectations and the article anatomy's requirement that the body work without the standfirst. Preserve the committed evaluation and its judgements. Settle how future contrast preparation and independent validation establish conformance before freezing a clean expectation, without weakening the body-independence requirement or treating a failed judgement as proof that Redline needs new wording.

The two contrasts in `docs/evaluation/editorial-486/inputs/` were independently validated by two native readers each for their intended distinction: a supported denominator inference that promises no hourly data, and an explicit promise to give sensor positions and window distances that the body never supplies. Both classifications were confirmed. The validation brief did not test the whole anatomy. The frozen judge expectations nevertheless call the inference text conforming and everything outside the promise conforming.

In `article-inference`, the lead starts `De 14 lektionspassen ingår i de 120 som fastighetskontoret räknade.` The condition selecting those fourteen periods appears in the standfirst and first section. Both native runs clarified that condition in the lead while preserving the supported inference in its next sentence. In `article-promise`, replacing the lead removed the original lead's first mention of `fastighetskontoret`, leaving the first body section's `Kontoret` dependent on the standfirst. Both native runs named the office in the body while correctly detecting and removing the genuinely unfulfilled promise, without inventing positions or distances.

All four runs were judged by two independent readers using #480's copied control briefs and neutral paths. Both judges on every run call these referent clarifications unnecessary or taste changes because the standfirst supplies the referent. In the two file-target runs the clarification is their deciding R1 failure. The anatomy explicitly requires the body to read complete without the standfirst and the lead to introduce every person, thing and event it mentions; its review extension asks the reviewer to cover the standfirst and repair references only it supplies. The judgements therefore expose a conflict with the frozen conformance assumption, rather than establish by themselves an additional product defect. The response-target headline findings belong to #480 and are separate from this issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Read the frozen plan, inputs, expectations, validation brief, all four validations, the two file-target artifact comparisons, and both judgements of all four runs in `docs/evaluation/editorial-486/` against the article anatomy and its review extension.
- [ ] Record whether the contrast inputs, the conformance assumption, or the judging method introduced the mismatch, keeping both original readings and the supported-inference/unfulfilled-promise distinction visible.
- [ ] Make the smallest justified preparation or judging correction for future evaluations, preserving committed freezes and without broadening Redline's authority or introducing a standfirst-dependence exception.
- [ ] Run the four checks in CONTRIBUTING.md for any repository change.

---
Written against `d8c36e42` (the plan-freeze commit; product instructions at `5457c894`).

comments.body:
New autonomous repair mandate, 2026-10-03. The future method correction is implemented in #499: finite complete-contract fixture preparation with two independent readers precedes the final committed evaluation freeze; counted and semantic anatomy, target classification and unrelated defects remain separate. Native editorial validation/review/correction/checker/semantic judging use gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh on CLI0.160.0. Whole-task verification uses fresh gpt-6-astra/high separately.

The additive diagnosis will preserve the #486 plan, both inputs/expectations, all four narrow validations, the two exact file comparisons and all eight contrast judgements. Original supported-inference/unfulfilled-promise classifications remain; the global conformance assumption and restricted judging packet introduced the anatomy conflict. No old result is regraded and no standfirst-dependence exception or product wording change is authorized by this issue.

Current acceptance retains every original criterion and requires the complete-contract preparation interface, explicit prospective freeze/record boundary, actual source digest audit and the unchanged four project checks. #499 is the method prerequisite; the native blocking relation carries it for scheduling. Root controls final integration and closure.
